testName: Platform Event Publishing and Asynchronous Subscriber DML Trigger
steps:
1. Open developer console or trigger custom action that publishes "Order_Event__e" event payload
2. In Apex execution log, confirm PLATFORM_EVENT_PUBLISH event is recorded
3. Verify subscriber Apex trigger or Flow consumes event payload
4. Navigate to Audit Log custom object and verify downstream record was generated by "Automated Process" user
5. Verify transaction commit guarantees zero data loss
